work.description: Brief CXXI providing for the election of Jean-Paul-Hilaire Contrezy as coadjutor of the Siam vicariate and bishop of Bida; address 18776–18778, protocol 18781, Datum 18938–18941. Internal gaps are running titles, page numbers, signatures and provenance citations only. Issuer evidence GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF18781. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
